en.title: The Simpsons Takes Over Monopoly Go! in Epic Summer Crossover Event
en.summary: Springfield's finest are rolling the dice in a massive new event for the hit mobile game Monopoly Go!. Get ready for iconic characters, familiar locations, and a whole lot of D'oh! moments as The Simpsons brand transforms the digital board.
en.body:
For a franchise as ubiquitous as **The Simpsons**, its presence in the gaming world has often felt surprisingly fragmented. While **The Simpsons: Tapped Out** enjoyed immense popularity before its delisting, and fans still hold out hope for a **Simpsons: Hit & Run** revival, the recent success of **Fortnite's** Springfield integration proved just how much appetite there is for interactive Simpsons content. Now, **Monopoly Go!** is stepping up to the plate, offering players a chance to dive headfirst into a wild, themed crossover event.

From June 3 to July 29, 2026, the entire world of **Monopoly Go!** will be reimagined through the lens of Springfield, USA. Players will take on the roles of beloved characters like **Homer**, **Marge**, **Bart**, and **Lisa**, acquiring iconic locations from the show as they play. The event promises to be packed with deep-cut references and delightful Easter eggs for long-time fans. A unique new gameplay mechanic will even allow players to attempt to bribe **Chief Wiggum** to escape jail, adding a distinctly Springfieldian twist to the classic **Monopoly** experience.

## Springfield's Finest on the Board

This isn't just a cosmetic overlay; **Monopoly Go!** is set to introduce a narrative component to the event. New story chapters will unfold bi-weekly, kicking off with an animated short that explores the legendary rivalry between **Mr. Burns** and **Mr. Monopoly**, hilariously voiced by **Will Ferrell**. This blend of familiar gameplay with fresh, franchise-specific content is designed to appeal to both casual players and dedicated **Simpsons** aficionados. The integration aims to capture the spirit and humor of the long-running animated series while leveraging the addictive mechanics of **Monopoly Go!**.

> "The entire game will be transformed and reimagined through the lens of Springfield, USA, as players take control of characters like Homer, Marge, Bart, and Lisa and buy up iconic locales from the show."

## What This Means for Fans

The crossover arrives as a welcome addition for a fanbase that has been actively seeking more interactive **Simpsons** experiences. Following **Fortnite's** successful integration, this **Monopoly Go!** event demonstrates a strategic effort by **20th Century Games** and **Scopely** to capitalize on the enduring appeal of **The Simpsons** in the digital space. It offers a new way for fans to engage with their favorite characters and universe, blending nostalgia with modern mobile gaming. The promise of new cosmetic rewards and a reimagined game world suggests a significant investment in making this a memorable event for the **Monopoly Go!** community and **Simpsons** fans alike.

## Looking Ahead

The **Monopoly Go!** and **The Simpsons** crossover event officially begins on June 3, 2026, and will run through July 29, 2026. Fans can anticipate new gameplay elements, story progression, and a wealth of Springfield-themed content throughout the summer.

tr.title: Simpsons, Monopoly Go!'da Büyük Kombine Oluşturdu: Yaz Gecesi Çarpışması
tr.summary: Springfield'in en iyileri, büyük bir yeni olay için Monopoly Go!'da kurşunu çekiyor. Iconik karakterler, tanıdık yerler ve çok fazla "D'oh!" anı ile birlikte, The Simpsons markası dijital püyayı yeniden canlandırıyor.
tr.body:
The Simpsons'un, oyun dünyasında sahip olduğu o kadar yaygın bir marka olmasının aksine, oyun dünyasındaki varlığı genellikle oldukça parçalı hissetmiştir. **The Simpsons: Tapped Out**'un delisted olmasına rağmen büyük bir popülariteye sahipken ve **Simpsons: Hit & Run**'ın bir yeniden canlandırma için umutları hâlâ devam ederken, **Fortnite**'in Springfield entegrasyonu recent başarısı, interaktif **The Simpsons** içeriği için ne kadar talep olduğunun kanıtı oldu. Artık, **Monopoly Go!** de sahneye çıkıyor ve oyunculara, Springfield'e atılmak için bir fırsat sunuyor.


Haziran 3-29, 2026 tarihleri arasında, **Monopoly Go!'**nin tüm dünyası Springfield, ABD'nin kılıcıyla yeniden canlandırılacak. Oyuncular, sevilen karakterler **Homer**, **Marge**, **Bart** ve **Lisa** olmak üzere rol alacaktır. Oyuncular, show'dan iconic yerleri satın alacaktır. Bu olay, uzun zamandır hayranların sevdiği derin kesim referansları ve keyifli Easter eggs ile dolu olacaktır. Oyuncular, **Chief Wiggum**'u yargıdan kaçmak için **Chief Wiggum**'u kandırmaya çalışacak yeni bir oyun mekanizmasıyla tanışacak. Bu, klasik **Monopoly** deneyimine bir çok Springfieldian twist ekleyecek.


Bu sadece bir dekorasyon değildir; **Monopoly Go!** bu olayda bir hikaye bileşeni sunacak. Yeni hikaye bölümleri haftada iki kez yayınlanacak ve **Mr. Burns** ve **Mr. Monopoly** arasındaki legenderyal rekabeti keşfedecek. Bu, yeni ve franchise spesifik içeriği ile bilinen gameplayin birleşiminden oluşmaktadır. Bu, hem yeni oyunculara hem de **The Simpsons** tutkunlarına hitap edecek.


"Tüm oyun, Springfield, ABD'nin kılıcıyla yeniden canlandırılacak. Oyuncular, Homer, Marge, Bart ve Lisa gibi karakterleri kontrol edecek ve show'dan iconic yerleri satın alacak."


Bu olay, uzun zamandır daha fazla interaktif **The Simpsons** deneyimini arayan hayranlar için bir iyi haberdir. **Fortnite**'in başarılı entegrasyonu, **20th Century Games** ve **Scopely**'nin **The Simpsons**'in dijital alanda sahip olduğu kalıcı çekiciliğe stratejik bir yaklaşım sergilediğini gösteriyor. Bu, hayranların favori karakterleri ve evreni ile daha fazla etkileşime girmelerini sağlar. Yeni kostüm ödülleri ve yeniden canlandırılan oyun dünyası, **Monopoly Go!'** topluluğu ve **The Simpsons** hayranları için unutulmaz bir olay olacağını gösteriyor.


**Monopoly Go!** ve **The Simpsons** kombine olayı, Haziran 3, 2026 tarihinde başlayacak ve Temmuz 29, 2026 tarihinde sona erecektir. Hayranlar, yaz boyunca yeni oyun öğeleri, hikaye ilerlemesi ve Springfield temalı içerik bekleyebilir.

es.title: La Familia Simpson se apodera de Monopoly Go!: un evento épico de crossovers de verano
es.summary: La familia del Sr. Burns y sus vecinos de Springfield se unen a Monopoly Go! en un emocionante evento de crossovers. Desde el 3 de junio al 29 de julio de 2026, el juego se transformará en una experiencia única y divertida para los fanáticos de la serie.
es.body:
Para una franquicia tan omnipresente como La Familia Simpson, su presencia en el mundo de los videojuegos ha sido sorprendentemente fragmentada. Si bien La Familia Simpson: Tapped Out disfrutó de una enorme popularidad antes de su desactivación, y los fanáticos siguen esperando una revivificación de La Familia Simpson: Hit & Run, el reciente éxito de la integración de Springfield en Fortnite demostró justamente cuánto apetito hay por contenido interactivo de La Familia Simpson. Ahora, Monopoly Go! está a punto de dar el salto, ofreciendo a los jugadores la oportunidad de sumergirse en un emocionante evento de crossovers temáticos.

Desde el 3 de junio hasta el 29 de julio de 2026, el mundo completo de Monopoly Go! se reimaginará a través del prisma de Springfield, USA. Los jugadores adoptarán los roles de personajes queridos como Homer, Marge, Bart y Lisa, adquiriendo ubicaciones icónicas de la serie a medida que juegan. El evento promete estar lleno de referencias profundas y huevos de Pascua encantadores para los fanáticos de larga data. Un nuevo mecanismo de juego único incluso permitirá a los jugadores intentar sobornar al Jefe Wiggum para escapar de la cárcel, agregando un toque distintivamente springfieldiano a la experiencia clásica de Monopoly.

## Springfield's Finest en la Mesa de Juego

No se trata solo de una capa de imagen; Monopoly Go! está a punto de introducir un componente narrativo en el evento. Los capítulos de la historia se desarrollarán cada dos semanas, comenzando con un corto animado que explora la legendaria rivalidad entre el Sr. Burns y el Sr. Monopoly, hilarantemente interpretado por Will Ferrell. Esta mezcla de juego familiar con contenido fresco y específico de la franquicia está diseñada para atraer a ambos jugadores casuales y aficionados dedicados de La Familia Simpson. La integración busca capturar el espíritu y el humor de la serie animada de larga duración mientras aprovecha las mecánicas adictivas de Monopoly Go!.

> "La familia del Sr. Burns y sus vecinos de Springfield se unen a Monopoly Go! en un emocionante evento de crossovers."

## Lo que esto significa para los fanáticos

El crossovers llega como una bienvenida adición para un fanbase que ha estado buscando activamente más experiencias interactivas de La Familia Simpson. Siguiendo la exitosa integración de Fortnite, este evento de Monopoly Go! demuestra un esfuerzo estratégico por 20th Century Games y Scopely para capitalizar la apelación duradera de La Familia Simpson en el espacio digital. Ofrece una nueva forma para que los fanáticos interactúen con sus personajes y universo favoritos, mezclando la nostalgia con el juego móvil moderno. La promesa de recompensas cosméticas nuevas y un mundo de juego reimaginado sugiere una inversión significativa en hacer que este evento sea memorable para la comunidad de Monopoly Go! y los fanáticos de La Familia Simpson.

## Mirando hacia adelante

El evento de crossovers de Monopoly Go! y La Familia Simpson comienza oficialmente el 3 de junio de 2026 y durará hasta el 29 de julio de 2026. Los fanáticos pueden esperar nuevos elementos de juego, progreso de la historia y una riqueza de contenido temático de Springfield a lo largo del verano.

content_raw: For as massive and ever-present a franchise as The Simpsons is, it doesn’t have the foothold in the video game arena you might expect. The wildly popular mobile game The Simpsons: Tapped Out was delisted in 2025 , and fans are still clamoring for a remaster of or sequel to The Simpsons Hit & Run . The recent success of Fortnite’s Simpsons crossover shows just how much pent-up demand there is for The Simpsons gaming content. Enter Scopely and its popular Monopoly Go! mobile game. Monopoly Go! Will be hosting a Simpsons-themed crossover event that lasts from June 3 through July 29. The entire game will be transformed and reimagined through the lens of Springfield, USA, as players take control of characters like Homer, Marge, Bart, and Lisa and buy up iconic locales from the show. The game will be completely packed with Simpsons references and Easter eggs, including a new gameplay mechanic where players can attempt to bribe Chief Wiggum to get out of jail. There will even be a story component to this The Simpsons event, with new chapters unfolding every two weeks. That story kicks off in the form of an animated short that explores the long-standing rivalry between Mr. Burns and Mr. Monopoly (voiced by none other than Will Ferrell). You can watch that animated short here . To learn more about what to expect from this Monopoly Go!/The Simpsons crossover, IGN spoke with The Simpsons executive producer and showrunner Matt Selman, GM of 20th Century Games and VP, Business Development John Drake, and Scopely’s VP Operations Joe Zanetti. Read on to learn more about this massive crossover and how it draws on decades of The Simpsons lore. From Fortnite to Monopoly Go! As mentioned, this new crossover is coming on the heels of a massive collaboration between Fortnite and The Simpsons in late 2025. Epic Games set a high bar for Scopely to meet, but all three men feel this crossover lives up to that standard. It even has one big advantage over the Fortnite crossover. Fortnite is a skill-based game, whereas Monopoly Go! is a much more casual experience with a potentially wider audience. “Fortnite is hard and requires skill, so we thought we’d give people the opposite experience with this collaboration, a really chillax game,” Selman tells IGN. “You can just leisurely play without worrying about getting shot. No snipe anxiety in this, my friends. Just a laid back, maxin’ and relaxin’, kind of fun chill-out game. Drake adds, “I think, to Matt's point, this game is far less sweaty than being in a life-or-death struggle in battle royale.” It would be easy to slap a Simpsons-flavored coat of paint on Monopoly Go! and call it a day, but Selman is adamant that this isn’t what happened.
